tori: Quick heads-up from migration QA: customers hitting v2 embeddings fail because examples still use `inputs`. We need a tiny migration note + example shim and a deprecation banner. cc @ben @alex

ben: Oof. Good catch. Suggest we add a short section under docs/guide/migration/embeddings.md titled 'inputs -> items shape change' and show both the minimal transform and a curl example.

alex: Agree. Also add a callout about vector dimension changes when swapping model families. People using vector stores will silently break.

tori: Draft JS snippet for the section: ```js
// migrate v1 body { inputs: ['a','b'] } -> v2 { items: [{text:'a'},{text:'b'}] }
const items = body.inputs.map(x => (typeof x === 'string' ? { text: x } : x));
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'redwood/embed-128', items });
```

ben: Nice. For the shim show a function normalizeBatch(body) that returns new body with items. Also include curl that posts JSON with items.

ci-bot: ci-bot: lint checks started for PR 4307

alex: Editorial: mark `inputs` as deprecated with exact timeline (deprecate 2026-06-01, removal 2026-09-01). Banner deploy aligned with July site build?

tori: I'll add the banner snippet and schedule with @docs-bot for the July release. PR will include cross-link to SDK changelog and a short FAQ entry: 'Why did my embedding index break?'.

ben: One more: add sample code to detect dim mismatch and surface a clear error, e.g. `if (index.dim !== embed.length) throw new Error('embedding-dim-mismatch')`. Saves support time.

docs-bot: sched: deprecation-banner PR scheduled for 2026-07-06 site build

tori: Thanks all. I'll assign reviewers and ping support to prep a Slack-ready note for customers who hit the shim behavior.

ben: LGTM once smoke is green.
